items.title: Formula V Line Air Power G10 回顾
items.summary: A sleek case with some less-than-sleek issues.

content.v: If you need to build yourself a PC, you will want as much freedom to be creative as possible, and Formula V's Air Power G10 not only promises some neat ways of messing with its layout, but comes with a whole heap of fans and a sweet aesthetic at the same time.

But alas, there's a big elephant in the room here in the form of its PSU space, and its 'almost budget but not quite as budget as other budget cases' price point makes it awkward when you consider the white variant is $10 more than the Black, Black Rose, and Wooden models. There's a lot here to love, but just enough to loathe that it's not a go-to "cheapish" case pick.
Buy if…
✅ You don't want to buy more case fans: The Power G10 has five 120 mm case fans, which is good enough that you won't need any more.
Don't buy if...
❌ You just want a white build: The likes of Corsair offer cheaper white cases. ❌ You have a chunky PSU: With a max size of 160 mm, this case can't fit the chunkiest of PSUs in it.
Features
Size
Mid-tower
Motherboard support
ATX / Micro-ATX / ITX
Dimensions
Maximum GPU length
420 mm
Radiator support
Up to 360 mm (top)
PSU support
ATX 160 mm
Fan support
3 x 120mm (front), 3 x 120 or 2 x 140 mm (top), 2 x 120 mm (bottom), 1 x 120 or 1 x 140 mm (rear), 2 x 140 mm (side)
Fans included
5 x 120 mm (three front, one bottom, one rear)
Storage bays
1 x 3.5-inch and 2 x 2.5-inch
Front panel
1 x USB Type-C, 2 x USB 3.0 Type-A, 1 x audio jack
Price
$100 for White, Black Titanium, and Dark Blue / $90 for Black, Black Rose Gold, and Wood

The Air Power G10 is interesting in a few ways. First, it has three 120 mm fans pre-installed at the front that are able to swivel up and down. They come with dust filters too, which is a nice touch. These are daisy-chained around the back of the case, which means you can simply connect these to the rear fan and bottom fan (all of which are included in the box), then into your motherboard.

You can take the front, top, and sides off the G10 without any tools; with tools, you can take off the PSU shroud and swap it with the bracer on the bottom for the rear fans. This is a relatively niche bit of customisation, but should you need to swap around the PSU position or want your fans pointing directly under the graphics cards, it's pretty simple to do so.

Formula V provides the 3D design files for the front panel. With these, you can design and attach your own panels and fan braces. I like a lot of the decisions made with the Air Power G10, and building a PC in it is not only easy but even rather fun thanks to a decent amount of open space and convenient access.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WToZtibjJLTAMtuYt4ZtfQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hKNMzuvy8HetgADhSCabhQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4WoqRMfLZnA3HtbbvbVdhQ-1920-80.jpg
Installation

If you have the right PSU, installation in the Air Power G10 is super easy. That’s a pretty big if, though. In the box, you get three front fans preinstalled and daisy-chained. You also get a back fan pre-installed, then one bottom fan, which is not installed. Simply connect the three back fans to the front fan and the bottom fan, then plug them into your motherboard, and you are good to go.

The case only supports PSUs up to 160 mm in length, which means many power supplies we had on hand simply would not fit in it. I tried with the Be Quiet! Dark Power 12, and Dark Power Pro, as well as the Cooler Master V1000. These three are bigger than the 160 mm Formula V advertises the Air Power G10 can fit, but it means you can't just grab any old PSU and throw it in. I had to shrink down to the Corsair SF600, a small-form-factor power supply, to get it hooked up with what we had in the office.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/s9ZauVbfEaR8TbxPUoTEjQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XkPbmCYAkKcNEVtVcpKfiQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2UPyoMN5tmLx3pAbytCWjQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/mJH2LsT2hSm66cbF8dFejQ-1920-80.jpg

You can take off the shroud above it, but that only gives the PSU some unnecessary headroom; it doesn't give much more length. And an exact 160 mm or less is a pretty tight squeeze, especially when you consider some PSU cables can be rather chunky and might have to be pressed against the side of the case for prolonged periods of time.

The case comes with a neat power cable that hooks from the back of the case underneath the rear fans, and then near the front to get to the PSU. This means your power cable will be colour-coded with your rig, but it also means you have to swap the PSU section and bottom fan shroud if your PSU power port is on the wrong side. You can take out this cable, but it leaves a big gap at the back of the case, which cheapens the clean aesthetic of the build.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5rxrAu7jgEE5JtZxVDexdQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aigYJgKg6dP3XMNYSZE3eQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8heKm7UyRxFZ3sRm966CeQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JoChSH3VYeSb8UJ4bJmpjQ-1920-80.jpg

Given you can open up the case from almost every angle but the back without any tools, I found myself only using the screwdriver in very select cases, like fastening the motherboard and kitting the AMD stock CPU cooler. You do need a screwdriver, but only sparingly, which also means having to keep track of fewer screws as you build.

PSU problems out of the way, the G10 has plenty of empty space in the back for cable management, and there are a couple of ties in the box once you're happy with it all. I'm no cable management pro, but I managed to get it looking tidy enough in a short amount of time. A big benefit of the three front fans being preinstalled is that they're relatively plug-and-play.
Aesthetics
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hdVKCdnLTmybCdv4zNKXbQ-1920-80.jpg

Aesthetics are the name of the game with the white model I got my hands on, especially when you consider it fetches $10 more than some of its non-white counterparts. And for that, it does look pretty sweet. The white steel is only ever disrupted by the silver of the screws, and they look tidy in application too. The top even has a small leather-like handle.
It is a lovely-looking case that looks even better when all the fans are spinning (assuming you daisy-chained it correctly).

I didn't even commit to an all-white build, and still found myself casually staring into its pretty spinning fans on more than one occasion. I even quite like the three-fan front panel, and its RGB lighting. It's sunken into the front panel, but sleek enough to look quite clean. The Air Power G10 manages to look like its own unique case without getting ugly in the process, which is an impressive feat.
Thermals
Formula V Line Air Power G10 Temperatures
Recorded with only the case fans that come with the G10 and a stock AMD CPU cooler

Max Minimum Average Formula V Line Air Power G10 64.8 56.4 59 0 20 40 60 80 GPU Temperatures Data Product Value Formula V Line Air Power G10 64.8 Max, 56.4 Minimum, 59 Average Max Minimum Average Formula V Line Air Power G10 91 81 75 0 25 50 75 100 CPU Temperatures Data Product Value Formula V Line Air Power G10 91 Max, 81 Minimum, 75 Average The rig I built was kitted with an AMD Ryzen 5 7600X , an XFX Swift AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT , 32 GB of memory, and two SSDs. Thanks to it being a large case and coming fitted with five 120 mm fans, the Air Power G10 has some rather solid temps. In a whole suite of gaming tests, the 9060 XT only ever got to a maximum of 64.8 °C and an average of 57 °C.

The CPU, on the other hand, got up to a max temperature of 91 °C, with an average of 81 °C. That's pretty high, but not the fault of the case. I stuck a simple stock AMD cooler on the CPU, and a 360 mm cooler up top would keep those CPU temps down. Still, airflow is solid in the case with the fans set to the positions Formula V intends (three on the front, one in the rear and one on the bottom).

items.title: 新的《霍格沃茨传奇》预告片展示了 Nvidia 的 DLSS 5 增强型照明和材质
items.summary: Nvidia just showed off DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy in a new video that shows how its AI-enhanced lighting and ma

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/04/hogwartslegacy-dlss5-1793806537149.png

Nvidia just showed off DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy in a new video that shows how its AI-enhanced lighting and materials model looks in-game. It’s a much more subtle effect compared to the images and clips going around after a leaked early version of DLSS 5 was modded into games .

Before, it looked like those yassification filters that were popular for like a week. It smoothed characters over, weirdly made some look about 30 years older, and generally warped the intended art style into something uncanny.

“On Thursday, November 5th, in collaboration with Warner Bros. Games and Avalanche Software, Hogwarts Legacy is updating the game to integrate DLSS 5 technology to enhance the lighting and materials, and use DLSS 5’s model controls to boost environmental uplift while preserving character identity,” Nvidia said.

According to the gargantuan tech company, DLSS 5 isn’t just a switch to be flipped — developers have to fine tune it and approve before release to hit the desired effect. It isn’t just about characters’ faces either. With the Neural Rendering option enabled, Nvidia claims shadows pop more, textures are upscaled, and reflections are sharper as the tech works in real-time to paint over the scene. You can see how it looks in Hogwarts Legacy in the video below.
Here's the official blurb from Nvidia:

DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering will be available starting November 5th in Hogwarts Legacy for all GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs and laptops, RTX Spark PCs, and GeForce NOW Ultimate. With the Neural Rendering option enabled, detail and shadows in environments are enhanced, texture detail on characters is improved, shading and lighting is refined, and reflections are more vibrant.

With the addition of DLSS with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering to Hogwarts Legacy, our complete suite of DLSS technologies is now supported, enabling you to accelerate and enhance your experiences in the wizarding world.

For an optimal experience, we also recommend enabling DLSS Super Resolution under “Upscale Type,” DLSS Multi Frame Generation under “Frame Generation,” NVIDIA Reflex under “Low Latency Mode,” and “DLSS Ray Reconstruction” if you’re also activating Hogwarts Legacy’s immersive ray-traced effects.
With DLSS 5 activated, Ray Reconstruction, 6X Multi Frame Generation, NVIDIA Reflex, and ray tracing enabled, the game runs at up to 300 FPS at 4K on the GeForce RTX 5090.

This month, DLSS 5 and its 3D-Guided Neural Rendering will be added to three new games: Hogwarts Legacy, War Thunder, and Where Winds Meet. Hogwarts Legacy will be upgraded to DLSS 5 on November 5, and War Thunder will upgrade later in mid-November. DLSS 5 will be available immediately for players on Where Wind Meets on launch on November 23.
DLSS 5 only works with GeForce RTX 50-Series GPUs and laptops, RTX Spark PCs, and GeForce NOW Ultimate, Nvidia’s cloud streaming games service.

items.title: 购买《塞尔达传说：时之笛》节省 10 美元的最后机会
items.summary: Physical copies of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time go back up to full price tomorrow, so now is your last

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/04/untitled-design-1-1793805989451.png

The reviews are in, and critics agree that the new remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a winner. Seriously, Metacritic has it at 96 at the time of this writing. If you’re looking to add this new Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive to your collection, today is your last chance to save $10 on a preorder . While preorders have sold out at Amazon , physical copies with the textured foil cover are still available at Walmart for $59.88. That’s $10 less than physical copies cost everywhere else .
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2) Is $10 Off
Just like all of Walmart’s preorder discounts on physical Switch 2 games, the deal will go away once the game comes out. And it comes out tomorrow, November 5.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a from-the-ground-up remake of the 1998 Nintendo 64 classic. While it hews close to the original in many respects, it brings modern graphics, movement, and camera controls to the party, among other quality-of-life improvements. And because the bones of the game are so sturdy, this new reimagining is a fantastic adventure that will appeal to newcomers and longstanding fans alike.

In IGN's Ocarina of Time review , Nintendo expert Logan Plant wrote, “The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is both an exceptional remake of an incredible game and a rich adventure that stands on its own. This remake proves there’s still so much value in the traditional Zelda formula: the dense, intimate world of Hyrule is stuffed with charming characters and fascinating secrets. Its intricate dungeons are satisfying to unravel, even if their somewhat streamlined design has slightly dulled the special feeling that comes from solving them. Still, the depth, quality, and attention to detail in every corner match the lofty reputation of this series. Whether you’ve played the original 100 times, once back in 1998, or never at all, I highly recommend this beautiful retelling of a legend.”

To go along with the game, Nintendo is releasing a number of Zelda-themed hardware items to go along with it (see our preorder guide for full details). Most of these have already sold out as preorders, but some will come back in stock on November 5 – including at Best Buy’s midnight launch for the game.
For more deals, check out our full Black Friday coverage, as some early sales have already gone live.

items.title: 战争机器电影真的会发生吗？导演权衡
items.summary: A Gears of War movie is in development at Netflix, but is it ever going to happen? That remains to be seen, bu

content.v: A Gears of War movie is in development at Netflix, but is it ever going to happen? That remains to be seen, but director David Leitch of John Wick fame recently said the movie will "hopefully" come to fruition "soon."
Speaking to ScreenRant , Leitch said, "I think everybody's excited about the potential of this as a film universe."
He added: "I wish I could tell you more, because there's some much cool stuff going on."

Netflix recently underwent a big shift in management, with film chief Dan Lin exiting the company alongside longtime chief content officer Bela Bajaria. Former Former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice is now the new chief content officer. He was only just recently installed in the post, so it remains to be seen what changes Rice could make. There is, however, precedent for new management making big changes, as Netflix's BioShock movie was scaled back under the leadership of Lin.
The latest script for the Gears of War movie as of 2025 was written by Jon Spaihts, who previously wrote Prometheus, Doctor Strange, and Passengers, along with Dune 1 and 2.
A decades-long wait

Gears of War fans have been waiting decades for their promised Gears of War movie. All the way back in 2007, a year after the first Gears of War game came out, New Line Cinema purchased the rights to make a movie based on the game. Nothing ever came of that. Then in 2016, the Gears of War movie rights changed hands and went to Universal . Nothing came of that, either.

In 2022, Netflix announced a deal with Microsoft to make not only a Gears of War movie, but also an animated TV series (which we don’t know anything about). It’s been four years since then and the project remains in development, but things tend to fall apart in Hollywood, so there are no guarantees it’ll actually happen.

Netflix is also working on an Assassin’s Creed TV show, and that one is actually going to happen, as it is now filming . Additionally, Netflix is behind the BioShock movie from The Hunger Games director Francis Lawrence, and it’s set to begin production in 2027 .
Who could be in the Gears of War movie?

Wrestler-turned-actor Dave Bautista has lobbied for years to play Marcus , and he does bear a strong resemblance to the character, but no casting announcements for the Gears of War movie have been made. He's already involved in a big video game project, as he's starring as Kratos in Prime Video's God of War show . Meanwhile, Gears of War designer Cliff Bleszinski has previously been adamant that Chris Pratt shouldn’t play any role in the film .
What about the Gears of War games?

The latest entry in the game series was this year's Gears of War: E-Day, a highly regarded action game that reportedly has not sold very well . No new games in the series have been announced, but developer The Coalition has said it won't take another seven years to make a follow-up.

Zooming further out, Xbox is undergoing a major "reset" that has included mass layoffs, game cancellations, and studio closures/divestitures. Developers at The Coalition said they fear for their jobs .

items.summary: 杨坤在访谈节目《静请期戴》中公开自己与抑郁症相伴二十年的经历，并首次解释跑调实为惊恐发作所致，此前《歌手》舞台的失误曾引发…

content.v: 据大皖新闻报道，杨坤在访谈节目《静请期戴》中公开自己与抑郁症相伴二十年的经历，并首次解释跑调实为惊恐发作所致，此前《歌手》舞台的失误曾引发广泛热议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261104_zy_red_164_20/175.jpg
杨坤2005年突发躯体崩溃，经诊断为抑郁症躯体化，此前多次就医均查不出器质性病变。从2005年至今每日服药从未中断，坦言“这个病去不了根”，需长期维持治疗。2026年11月4日做客李静、戴军主持的《静请期戴》，主动公开病情并首次详谈躯体化经历。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261104_zy_red_164_20/1200.jpg
2026年6月《歌手2026》第五期，杨坤因演唱《母亲的河》时开篇音准严重跑调，最终以19.63%的得票率垫底淘汰‌。‌‌当时恰逢父亲七十八岁高龄摔成全身粉碎性骨折，杨坤在医院看到影像后突发惊恐昏厥，恰逢《歌手》录制前期。登台时心跳剧烈、脚筋抽搐、肢体失控，导致严重跑调，自己当时完全未察觉。得知跑调登上热搜后彻夜难眠，与助手抱头痛哭，陷入对职业能力的深度怀疑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261104_zy_red_164_20/1385.jpg

content.v: 据中国蓝新闻报道，上海一位方女士选择工作日长住酒店，将月居住成本压至约3600元且包含早保洁停车，这笔账算下来，竟比她此前租住的同地段老旧公寓每月综合开销还省下一截 。
方女士与酒店协商达成每晚300元的长住协议价，仅周一入住、周五退房，按每周4晚计算，每月实际入住天数约12至16晚，月均支出由此锁定在约3600元的基础线上，最多4800元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261104_zy_red_164_19/1160.jpg
她此前租住的市区20平方米老旧公寓，月租加上水电、停车等费用，每月综合开销超过5000元。改用酒店模式后，每月至少省下约1000至2000元 。她远郊有自有住房，选择市区酒店解决了通勤奔波问题，将工作日完全聚焦于“出门上班，回来休息” 。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261104_zy_red_164_19/1283.jpg
每晚300元并非纯房费，而是打包了停车、每日双份早餐与客房打扫等酒店服务。对比传统租房单独支付水电、保洁等隐性成本，价格更为透明 。无需自己打扫卫生、维修家具或与房东沟通，点外卖有机器人送至房间，整体节省了大量生活精力 。

items.title: 前光环作曲家马蒂·奥唐纳在内华达州国会竞选中落败
items.summary: One of the minds behind the legendary music of Halo fell short in his mission to pivot to politics. Marty O'Do

content.v: One of the minds behind the legendary music of Halo fell short in his mission to pivot to politics. Marty O'Donnell, formerly a composer and audio director for Bungie, lost his bid to join the U.S. House of Representatives by a wide margin.

With 86% of votes counted, AP News called the race in Nevada's 3rd congressional district for incumbent Representative Susie Lee, a Democrat. O'Donnell ran as a Republican and had the endorsement of President Donald Trump. The current count has O'Donnell with 38.6% of the vote, trailing Lee's 59.1%. Nevada's 3rd district includes much of Clark County and part of Las Vegas.

Lee, who has held her seat since 2019, has been a target of Republicans in previous election cycles. As it became clear early Wednesday morning that Lee was favored to win re-election, her social media account posted the famous "Halo theme song performed by 80 guys in 1 bathroom" video to mock O'Donnell. O'Donnell responded by saying in a post: "Susie has a lot of class. And it’s all low."

O'Donnell heavily leaned on his video game industry background, hosting a campaign event that doubled as a celebration of early Halo games . At the event, O'Donnell declared that "gamers are not woke" and insisted that games, movies, and comics were "co-opted by left-wing politics."

As Lee's social media video hints at, this wasn't O'Donnell's first attempt at entering national politics. O'Donnell ran for the same congressional seat in 2024 , placing fourth in the Republican primary. He won the Republican nomination in 2026 with the backing of Trump.

O'Donnell began his career in video game music composition as a freelancer, producing the music for Bungie's Myth and Myth 2. He joined Bungie as a full-time employee starting with 2001's Oni and went on to compose music for all of Bungie's Halo titles and the first Destiny game. O'Donnell was fired from Bungie in 2014; the composer claimed that he was terminated "without cause" and pursued legal action against the company afterward. According to his campaign website, O'Donnell is now retired from the game industry.

items.title: 王自如称百万级以下油车没有未来 陈震：不完全认同
items.summary: 王自如发文称，他内心是油车发烧友，但百万级以下的油车已经没有未来了，无论是从经济性还是使用感受上。

content.v: 王自如发文称，他内心是油车发烧友，但百万级以下的油车已经没有未来了，无论是从经济性还是使用感受上。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611042317255721.jpg
主要原因是整车电子电器架构的前瞻设计，没有底层架构托底的智能化系统，都是在老平台上做后期加装和功能堆砌。看着光鲜，底层框架改不动，潜力先天受限，再怎么折腾都只是困在旧体系里打转。
对此，陈震表示，不完全认同王自如的观点。他提到，自己虽然平时开电车多，但一直也是油车爱好者。这就像智能手表很流行，但依然会有很多人为机械表买单一样。油车有自己的魅力，只是可能一些老旧的造车思路，在易用性方面确实需要来点创新。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611042317336985.png
王自如回复称，他始终认为，在综合体验上百万级以下燃油车没有太大的未来。首先，目前为止还没有哪台燃油车的智能辅助驾驶很好用，也还没机会体验过智能座舱很好用的传统燃油车；如果有的话，他会很期待。
另外，这其实不是加个激光雷达、冰箱彩电大沙发的事。哪怕给燃油车装上激光雷达、大屏幕，也只是“外挂方案”：传感器、域控和整车底盘是割裂的，信号延迟、融合上限、OTA迭代能力天然受限。
座舱体验和智驾的持续进化能力，很难追上从底层就按电气化定义的车型，所以上限就不太可能高。

items.summary: As PlayStation prepares to embrace an all-digital future starting in 2028, Nintendo is seen as one of the last

content.v: As PlayStation prepares to embrace an all-digital future starting in 2028, Nintendo is seen as one of the last bastions of physical games with its Switch cartridges. A new challenge has emerged: one of Nintendo's major ROM chip manufacturers, Macronix, is preparing to exit the market and shift its focus to the more lucrative flash and memory chip market.

In its latest earnings call (via MST Financial analyst David Gibson ), Macronix revealed it plans to drop ROM manufacturing entirely. The company says ROM chips account for only 5% of its business, down from 26% a year ago. While Macronix isn't the only company that manufactures ROM chips for Nintendo, it is a major supplier overall, and losing it could put further pressure on the company and other game publishers to ship more games on Game-Key Cards, or increase prices for cartridges that do have full games installed.

ROM chips--which stand for Read-Only Memory--are specialized storage chips that data is permanently written to. The great thing about them is that they let games load quickly, since a console can read the game code straight off the chip without first installing data to an internal storage drive. Nintendo's proprietary game cards rely on specialized, high-speed ROM tech tailored specifically for Nintendo hardware.

Because of that design, they have high manufacturing costs and only a handful of silicon suppliers--including MegaChips and ROHM--manufacture them for Nintendo. This, in turn, affects publishers' profit margins, which is why Game-Key Cards on Switch 2 are a popular alternative. In comparison, they act as digital authentication keys that require a game to be downloaded directly to the Switch 2 flash storage.
We have reached out to Nintendo, and will update this post if we hear back from them.

The rise of AI companies has also had an impact on virtually every aspect of consoles, and memory is no exception, as prices have risen dramatically over the last two years. Several tech companies have also shifted from selling products to consumers to selling exclusively to AI companies, which have an incredible appetite for memory and storage. That pivot has proven lucrative, as all the RAM for 2027 looks to be sold out already .
For its part, Nintendo says it doesn't plan to abandon physical games yet, as it prefers to offer consumers an "agnostic" platform to play games on.

items.title: 美国中期选举胜利后，民主党人在推特上用 Halo Monk 的口号嘲笑前 Bungie 作曲家马蒂·奥唐纳 (Marty O'Donnell)
items.summary: Republican Marty O'Donnell has lost his bid for Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District at the U.S. midterm electi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/04/gettyimages-2294056424-1793803334234.jpg

Republican Marty O'Donnell has lost his bid for Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District at the U.S. midterm elections despite a last-minute endorsement from Donald Trump, putting his political future in doubt.

O'Donnell is best-known to gamers as the composer of the original Halo games and Destiny at Bungie, but following his retirement from video games, he launched a career in politics and a bid for Congress. This year, O'Donnell launched a campaign to — with Trump’s support — unseat Nevada's 3rd Congressional District Democrat incumbent Susie Lee .

Unfortunately for O'Donnell, he lost the vote 38.6% to Lee’s 59.1%. 146,863 voted for Lee, with 95,845 voting for O'Donnell. The result came hot on the heels of a tweet endorsement from Trump himself , viewed 1.8 million times, in which the President called O’Donnell an “America First Patriot.”
Here’s Trump’s tweet in full:

“Marty is running against Susie Lee, a true Radical Left Extremist who does not represent the Values of Southern Nevada. Susie Lee wants Open Borders, Men playing in Women’s Sports, Transgender for Everyone, Defund the Police, and she wants to take away your Second Amendment, meaning, your guns. She voted AGAINST the Biggest Tax Cut in History (including NO TAX ON TIPS!), and fought ferociously to knock out Rural Healthcare, a big factor in Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District.

“In contrast, Marty O’Donnell is a World Class Composer and Entrepreneur who knows the America First Policies required to Create GREAT Jobs, Cut Taxes and Regulations, Promote NO TAX ON TIPS, Advance MADE IN THE U.S.A., Unleash American Energy DOMINANCE, and Champion our Nation’s Golden Age. As your next Congressman, Marty will fight tirelessly to Keep our Border SECURE, Stop Migrant Crime, Ensure LAW AND ORDER, Strengthen our Brave Military/Veterans, and Protect our always under siege Second Amendment.
“Marty O'Donnell has my Complete and Total Endorsement to be the next Representative from Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District. GET OUT AND VOTE FOR MARTY — HE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN!”

Following the win, Lee tagged O'Donnell in a tweet which declared: “Enjoy your retirement.” The tweet includes a video of Halo fans singing the iconic monk chant from the game, with O'Donnell’s tweet, “Well, I never wanted to be a politician and now I don’t have to be. Yay!” from 2024 overlaid. That 2024 tweet followed a similarly bruising political failure at the same Congressional seat, which touches parts of Las Vegas.
Enjoy your retirement @MartyTheElder https://t.co/vH8KwKWrdl
O’Donnell, clearly upset by Lee’s tweet, responded : “Susie has a lot of class. And it’s all low.”

What went wrong for O’Donnell this time? Apart from the midterm results being disastrous overall for the Republicans due to what is a clear rejection of Trump’s recent policies, Trump’s tariffs have hit O’Donnell's district hard, with Canadian tourism to Sin City down by 17% .

Collaborating with Michael Salvatori, O'Donnell composed the score of numerous Bungie games, from 1997's Myth to the classic sounds of Halo: Combat Evolved, in a lengthy tenure that ended with his work for 2014's Destiny.

2014 also saw O'Donnell fired from Bungie, resulting in a legal tussle over witheld pay. Bungie later initiated its own legal dispute with O'Donnell in 2021, after the composer uploaded unreleased Destiny music to YouTube.

Recent years have seen O'Donnell demonstrate an increasing interest in politics, after a lengthy period spent establishing his own game development studio, Highwire Games, that worked on VR title Golem back in 2019, and controversial shooter Six Days in Fallujah, which launched in early access form in 2023.
O’Donnell’s political future is now unclear, although perhaps after his second defeat in Nevada in two years, he may now actually enjoy his retirement.
Photo by Bill Clark/CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images.

items.title: PlayStation 黑色星期五促销活动开启，数字 PS5 游戏大幅折扣
items.summary: PlayStation’s Black Friday sale is live, with big discounts on digital PS5 games.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/04/untitled-design-1793801316901.png

It’s official: Black Friday season is upon us. As Sony announced yesterday , the PlayStation Store has kicked off its Black Friday sale (you can see the whole sale here ). The sale runs November 4 - 30, dropping prices on thousands of digital PS5 games. These range from older titles you’d expect to get discounts to new 2026 games like Wolverine, Control Resonant, Silent Hill: Townfall, and many more. Let’s take a look.
PlayStation Store Black Friday Sale

Before we dive in, it’s worth noting that these deals are just the beginning of the Black Friday season, and they may not be the best deals we'll see on these games. With Black Friday coming in just a few weeks, other retailers will certainly have some of these games on sale as well, likely for lower prices as the month progresses. So keep that in mind when planning your purchases.

Also, Sony said its Black Friday sale will run November 4 - 30; however, many game pages in this sale say the discounts will only last until November 21. I’m not 100% sure why that is, but I have to assume another wave of discounts will go live as we get closer to Black Friday. With that out of the way, let’s look at what’s on sale.

The biggest first-party PS5 game of the fall is Marvel’s Wolverine, from Insomniac, the makers of the Spider-Man PS5 games. It’s a fun (and very gory) single-player action game that tells a good story, though our reviewer scored it a 6/10 . Only the digital deluxe edition is on sale, but the discount actually makes it cheaper than the standard edition by $10. In addition to get base game, it includes a host of exclusive suits and claw skins, as well as some in-game help in the form of Technique Points.

On the other hand, if you have a PS5 with a disc drive, you can get a pre-owned copy of the standard edition on sale at GameStop for $38.99 right now. That's an example of other retailers possibly offering bigger discounts than you'll find in the PlayStation Store's sale. The more flexible you can be in terms of format and retailer, the better deals you'll be able to score this month.

As for other games on sale, Control Resonant is another big new game of the fall. And once again, it’s the digital deluxe edition that’s on sale instead of the standard edition. It comes with an extra outfit, a starter resource bundle, and a digital artbook and soundtrack. The deluxe edition of 007: First Light is on sale for 50% off; it also includes some in-game outfits and extras.

If standard editions are more your speed and you dig horror, you can pick up Silent Hill: Townfall for a cool 20% off. Beast of Reincarnation is on sale for 25% off. And a whole lot more games are discounted as well.

But once again, if you want the best deals possible, you’ll likely find bigger discounts in the weeks to come. If you want my advice, for now just buy the games you’ll start playing very soon. For everything else, make a list of what games you want and keep an eye out for all the PS5 game sales to come.

items.title: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel Will Show Us Just How Serious Xbox Is About Exclusivity
items.summary: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is created by an Xbox-owned studio, but will Microsoft make it an Xbox exclusive

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/04/sentinel-xbox-1793791749240.jpg
This is an IGN opinion piece from Ryan McCaffrey, IGN's "Xbox guy" and host of Xbox Unlocked .

The Elder Scrolls 6 finally has a full title : The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel. That means we know where it’s set (in the region of Hammerfell), and we know…well, that’s about it for now. We don’t know how it’ll look, what the story will be, or when it will be released. By all accounts, Sentinel is still years away – likely at least two – which leads to a couple of very interesting and very critical questions for Xbox: will it be a day-one launch title for the next-gen Xbox console/gaming PC hybrid codenamed Project Helix? And the even bigger question, will it be an Xbox console exclusive?

Before you laugh at the mere suggestion of that latter question, let’s review our gaming history. It wouldn’t be the first time an Elder Scrolls game was exclusive to Xbox. In fact, it’s happened twice before! The Elder Scrolls 3: Morrowind introduced Bethesda’s RPG series to the console audience, and it did that solely via the original Xbox in 2002, as Morrowind never came to PlayStation. Its next-gen follow-up (and my favorite game in the series so far ), The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion, was supposed to be a launch title for the Xbox 360. It didn’t quite make day one, but it helped usher in the HD Era just four months later in March 2006, and became a de facto Xbox exclusive by virtue of the fact that the PS3 didn’t come out until the Fall of that year. In fact, PS3 didn’t get its Oblivion port until March of 2007, giving Xbox a full year of exclusivity.

Skyrim, meanwhile, was a multiplatform release right out of the gate in 2011, and has gone on to become one of the ten biggest-selling games of all time , with over 65 million copies sold. And therein lies Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s dilemma when it comes to the upcoming Sentinel. Without question, it is the biggest game Xbox has in its portfolio, by any metric: sales potential, hype level, critical potential, you name it. Next week marks the 15th anniversary of Skyrim, giving The Elder Scrolls a Grand Theft Auto-like buildup between entries in the series. 13 years between GTA 5 and GTA 6? “Hold my ale,” says The Elder Scrolls. “Try 17 years – at least – between the last one and the next one!” The point is, no matter how you slice it, the launch of The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is going to be enormous.

Which brings me back to my original questions. First, might Sentinel be a day-one launch title for the Helix? By sheer luck, it’s entirely possible that the timelines of both projects might converge. It’d be a boon for Microsoft if they did, certainly, though the company definitely isn’t going to force the issue. Or at least, it’d be a massive mistake to try and rush Bethesda. It didn’t end well when Halo Infinite was announced as a day-one Xbox Series X release ; 343 Industries needed another year , and thankfully the studio got it. The 2028 timeline is largely guesswork; it could easily end up being 2029, I admit. But what I’m certain of is that it’s definitely too early to know. Heck, The Elder Scrolls director Todd Howard tried to call his release-date shot way in advance on Starfield, and that didn’t work out .

But – and it’s a big but – there is a chance that both the Helix and The Elder Scrolls 6 might both be ready to go at the same time in the Fall of 2028. To be clear, I imagine there’s a 99.9% chance that there will also be an Xbox Series X version of Sentinel as well; if this generation has taught us anything, it’s that publishers are not willing to start over with each new console generation and instead they want cross-gen games they can sell to hundreds of millions of players rather than an audience of just a few million on a new machine.

If the two timelines match, it represents a massive opportunity for Xbox to push its next-gen console, particularly if the Helix version has tangible player benefits. Sure, higher-resolution textures and zippier load times are nice, but I’m talking about things like running Sentinel’s inevitably huge and highly detailed open-world at a rock-solid 4K/60fps at all times – something even GTA 6 likely won’t be doing on the current-gen Series X or PS5 (or PS5 Pro, for that matter).

It gets even more interesting for Microsoft if, to return to the second question, Sharma decides to make The Elder Scrolls 6 exclusive to Xbox. After all, the new CEO has pledged a return to exclusives , starting with the outstanding Gears of War: E-Day this year and inXile’s promising first-person steampunk RPG Clockwork Revolution in 2027. If Sharma plays the Sentinel-sized ace up her sleeve, it’s going to tempt a not-insignificant number of gamers who jumped ship from Xbox to PlayStation since the Xbox One/PS4 era to consider coming back. Sure, The Elder Scrolls’s biggest audience has traditionally been and will likely continue to be on PC, but with nearly 100 million PS5s in living rooms around the world, that’s a lot of gamers to potentially withhold the biggest game of the decade not named GTA 6 from. But it also just might work, because Sentinel’s release will be both a pop-culture event and first chance to return to the beloved world of Tamriel in a very, very long time (with all due respect to the very-much-alive MMORPG, The Elder Scrolls Online, and the Oblivion remaster, of course).
The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel - The Lore You Need to Know
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/theelderscrolls6-blogroll-1793717906017.jpg

The worst-kept secret in gaming has finally been confirmed: yes, The Elder Scrolls 6 has a title. It’s called Sentinel, and will take place in Hammerfell. But what is Sentinel? And why could this much-anticipated swords-and-scorcery game involve giant robots? Learn everything you need to know in our The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel lore explainer .

There’s another potential scenario where Xbox does publish Sentinel on PS5…but not on PS6, meaning the place to play the best version of The Elder Scrolls 6 is only on Xbox. However, that’s admittedly a half-assed measure that I don’t think would really move many consoles for Microsoft. In that case, I suspect most gamers would happily buy it on PS5 and forget all about a Helix version – especially when both Helix and PlayStation 6 are likely to be extremely expensive .

Regardless of what happens with Helix, though, if the past few years of Xbox’s multiplatform experiment have shown anything, it’s that inconsistency isn’t helping. Indiana Jones and the Great Circle was exclusive to Series X for a few months. Avowed and South of Midnight came to PS5 after a year. Halo: Campaign Evolved and Gears of War Reloaded were multiplatform straight away. There was no clear-cut strategy. Now that Sharma has put Xbox back on the exclusives bandwagon, the brand has to be all-in. If it hopes to win gamers back, it can’t be selective about its biggest first-party games. The Elder Scrolls isn’t Call of Duty. It doesn’t ship every year with a long history of being on both Xbox and PlayStation. It will have been nearly two decades since Skyrim by the time Sentinel finally ships, and more to the point, no platforms have been announced as of yet. Plus, as I mentioned, Xbox does have an established history of exclusivity with this franchise.

《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元。
据了解，薄彩生在接受英国知名娱乐媒体METRO采访时透露，他不会参与下一部《影之刃》作品的开发。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041022209684.png
METRO先是提及了薄彩生之前的发言，询问他是否在暗示，这可能是他参与制作的最后一款《影之刃》系列游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041025363940.webp
随后，薄彩生给出了肯定的答复。他表示：“是的，因为我认为我们S-Game整个团队已经倾尽了所有。关于武侠和中国奇幻题材的游戏，我们已经做到了自己想做的一切。”
“如果你现在让我再为一款以武侠为灵感的游戏创作音乐，我甚至不知道还能写些什么。这就是我说它可能是最后一款的原因。因为说实话，我觉得自己已经做得够多了（笑）。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041025209905.png
不过，这并不意味着他彻底收手退出行业，他补充表示：“所以，我现在正在参与《湮灭之潮》的制作。这款游戏采用西方背景设定（实际上以伦敦为舞台），因此我终于可以尝试各种西方奇幻音乐元素和管弦乐编曲了。相比目前一直在做的中国风题材，这也算是一次不错的调剂，你懂我的意思吧？（笑）”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041025307826.png
在之后的一个问题中，METRO又询问道：“那么，如果有人真的给你一笔巨额预算，让你再做一次这样的作品，你会拒绝吗？”
薄彩生笑着回答道：“没错。我不需要这笔钱！”

items.title: GTA 6 迄今为止已售出近 1000 万份，PS5 占据主导地位（当然）
items.summary: The video game research company Sensor Tower has updated its GTA 6 sales tracker to reveal the latest, albeit

content.v: The video game research company Sensor Tower has updated its GTA 6 sales tracker to reveal the latest, albeit unofficial, sales data for the open-world crime game. According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has now sold 7.71 million total units via pre-purchases, which works out to about $751 million in gross revenue.

The report said PS5 sales are dominating the mix, with GTA 6 selling 5.74 million units on PS5 so far, compared to 1.97 million on Xbox Series X|S. That means of the 7.71 million GTA 6 sales so far, 74% are on PS5 and 26% on Xbox Series X|S.

In total, GTA 6 sales for PS5 have so far reached $559 million in revenue, compared to $192 million for Xbox Series X|S. Sony and Microsoft keep about 30% of revenue due to their platform fees, so GTA 6 being a huge success directly benefits both of those companies.

The huge gap in sales between platforms is not surprising because the PS5 is dominating Xbox Series X|S in terms of console sales. In fact, GTA 6 is breaking records on Xbox , Microsoft has said, and the sales numbers for GTA 6 on Xbox line up with Xbox's share of the console market .

Sensor Tower is projecting as many as 25 million total pre-purchases for GTA 6 by launch , and if the 74/26 split holds, that would be about 18.5 million units on PS5 and 6.5 million on Xbox Series X|S.

Sony holds the marketing rights for GTA 6 on PS5, but that doesn't mean that Microsoft is doing nothing to try to promote the game. Just recently, Microsoft announced a GTA 6-inspired custom Xbox console that sits inside an alligator.

Circana has released new data that shows that GTA 6 holds 29% purchase intent among US console and PC gamers. That means nearly 1 in 3 console and PC gamers in the US plan to buy GTA 6 –this is the highest purchase intent that Circana has ever measured for any game.

GTA 6 may indeed be a gigantic hit commercially, and one that helps lift the entire industry with increased sales of hardware and accessories. But anyone looking to buy a new console to play GTA 6 is set for major sticker shock, as consoles today are more expensive than ever. Not only that, but GTA 6 is not going to save the industry’s many serious and deep-rooted issues, experts believe .

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game's file size is about 212GB , and thankfully, preloading begins more than a week before launch. The game unlocks on November 19 at midnight local time , and that means US players will be among the last in the world to get in.
People in New Zealand, meanwhile, will be the first in the world to play GTA 6. If you're thinking about booking a flight to the land of Hobbits, here are some tips for packing your PS5 safely.

content.v: 据分析机构 Alinea Analytics 的最新估算数据显示，国产武侠动作游戏《影之刃零》目前在Steam和PS5平台已售出约 430万份（此前官方已经宣布销量破400万），总收入高达2.23亿美元（约14.8亿人民币）。
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元！
凭借这一惊人的吸金能力，《影之刃零》已直接跃升为2026年（统计涵盖 Steam、Xbox 和 PlayStation 平台）付费收入排名第10的新游戏。
值得一提的是，这一成绩还是在游戏尚未登陆Xbox平台的情况下取得的，含金量十足。
在玩家地域分布方面，中国大陆、台湾和香港地区构成了绝对的销量主力，合计占总销量的55%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611040911217556.jpg
具体到各平台，在Steam平台这三个地区的销量占比达56%，在PlayStation平台，这三个地区则占据了50%。
不过，由于不同地区的定价策略差异，这些地区在总收入中的占比略低于销量占比，合计贡献了总收入的45%。
细分来看，中国大陆、台湾和香港地区占PlayStation平台收入的 40%，占 Steam 平台收入的 47%。
作为一款刚刚发售的硬核动作游戏，《影之刃零》凭借出色的战斗体验在全球市场取得了口碑与商业的双丰收。随着后续内容更新以及其他平台（如传闻中的 Xbox 版）的拓展，本作的商业表现有望进一步攀升。

content.v: 由你来说： 《影之刃零》中花千笑BOSS战中魂的动作引发了日本玩家的讨论，却引发了一场乌龙。你怎么看？
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元！
近日，有日本玩家在社交平台发文，讨论了《影之刃零》中的一场BOSS战斗，其角度之清奇，引发了中日两国玩家的探讨。
该日本玩家在推文中提到：“在精准闪避‘花千笑’的飞剑时，魂大人用脚夹住剑并将其‘嗖’地一下踢飞出去的动作，真的很色（えろい）。”在日文语境中，“えろい”除了指代色情外，也常用于形容极其性感、充满魅惑力或让人心跳加速的帅气表现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041216044712.png
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/origin_202611041223122457.gif
此言一出，立刻引来了其他日本网友的共鸣，有玩家留言附和称：“这游戏的动作模组，每一个都既时尚又性感。”
然而，当这番评价被中国玩家看到后，却让不少国内玩家一头雾水。
由于语言和语境的差异，许多中国玩家对“色情”这个词的使用感到不解与震惊，纷纷留言：“色情？？这个词在日本是不是有其他用法？”“难道是翻译的问题吗？色……色情？？”“这家伙在说什么呢！？”
不过，也有国内玩家在震惊之余，完美get到了日本玩家想要表达的那个点，并回复：“冒昧回复抱歉，但是我超级能理解啊！！还有魂大人的一些处决动作，也是既暴力又帅气，看的人性欲旺盛呢。”

items.title: 曝GTA6首发Pro也无60帧！主机连40帧都没有 就30帧
items.summary: 开发者转述称主机版目前跑30帧，60帧选项仍待技术团队确认。

content.v: 随着《GTA6》即将在接下来的几天内正式发售，外媒Insider Gaming也撰写了一篇指南文章，旨在梳理目前《GTA6》全部传闻和已确认的画面设置。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/04/cas_auto/small_0_9279324.jpg
据了解，根据一位《GTA6》开发者的说法，本作似乎不会在发售时为Xbox Series X|S、基础版PS5以及PS5 Pro提供专门的60帧模式。
最初，关于60帧模式的传闻随着Rock and Borys播客节目的一则爆料而愈演愈烈。节目声称，《GTA6》推出60帧画面模式的可能性“非常大”，但同时暗示该模式可能不会在游戏发售时提供。
这一说法似乎得到了Rockstar North首席开发者兼联合总监Rob Nelson的印证。他在接受Kotaku采访时表示，主机目前运行游戏的帧率为30 FPS。
此外，相关报道还提到：“据这位总监透露，目前仍需要与技术团队进行沟通，才能确定游戏在发售时（或未来）是否会提供60 FPS选项。他还强调，自己目前并不了解游戏的分辨率以及光线追踪等其他技术细节，但就目前而言，游戏的运行帧率为30 FPS。”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/04/cas_auto/small_0_9279326.jpg
因此，Insider Gaming表示，可以比较肯定的认为，《GTA6》发售时很可能不会提供60帧选项。不过，Rockstar也有可能在游戏发售后通过更新加入这一模式。
尽管此前有传闻称《GTA6》可能提供60帧甚至40帧的画面模式，但目前来看，游戏发售时似乎只会提供传统的30帧模式，类似于其他游戏中的“画质模式”。
在游戏通过Netflix进行展示后，Digital Foundry对此进行了进一步分析。
“提供给Netflix和YouTube的视频素材（Rockstar官方网站上也能看到）是一段30帧的视频。这种做法存在诸多问题（主机的输出帧率为60 FPS，只有在游戏能够完美、稳定地维持30 FPS时，视频才能准确反映实际游戏画面），但最重要的是，开发者认为这样的展示已经足够，因为游戏本身的目标帧率就是30 FPS——如今这一点似乎已经得到了百分之百的确认。”
Digital Foundry还进一步强调，游戏可能会在发售后追加其他画面设置。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/04/cas_auto/small_0_9279327.jpg
Insider Gaming总结表示，《GTA6》很可能会以30 FPS的帧率发售。玩家暂时不应该期待游戏在发售前提供其他帧率选项，即使未来会有更多模式，也很可能要等到游戏正式发售之后。

items.title: 曾期盼活着玩到GTA6 绝症玩家病逝 年仅25岁
items.summary: 他自17岁起与间质性肺病抗争，家属通过社媒确认了死讯。

content.v: 8月份时我们 曾报道 ，一名25岁的玩家此前曾在网上分享自己的愿望，希望能够活到Rockstar Games新作《GTA6》发售的那一天，因此引起了游戏社区的广泛关注。然而，据Dexerto报道，近日传来消息，这名玩家已经不幸去世。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/04/cas_auto/small_0_9280410.jpg
据了解，这名玩家从17岁起便一直饱受间质性肺病（Interstitial Lung Disease）的折磨，病情后来不断恶化，最终需要接受肺移植手术。
他的家人确认，他于2026年10月29日去世。在此之前，他先后遭遇多次感染，健康状况持续恶化。而就在几个月前，许多网友还曾为他的故事伸出援手，筹集了数万美元用于支付医疗费用。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/04/cas_auto/small_0_9280411.jpg
11月2日，一名家属通过TikTok发布视频，透露他在去世前几周出现了严重感染，导致肺部充满积血。
据称，医生当时告知家属，他可能已经无法挺过这次病情，并建议考虑临终关怀。不过，他最初仍选择继续接受治疗，并依靠包括ECMO（体外膜肺氧合）在内的生命支持设备维持生命。ECMO是一种用于辅助心脏和肺部功能的医疗设备。
然而，他的病情仍在持续恶化。10月28日，他告诉家人，自己已经做好了放弃治疗的准备。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/04/cas_auto/small_0_9280421.jpg
第二天早上，家人接到医院电话，得知他在夜间再次出现感染，血液检查结果进一步恶化，身体各个器官也开始衰竭。
家人赶到病床前时，发现他的意识状态已经不如前一天，几乎无法再像此前那样对外界作出反应。
“他走得很平静。他很安详，真的非常安详。他不再挣扎了，也不再承受痛苦，不再受折磨了。”这名家属说道。
此前，他的母亲Paris Fort曾发起一项名为“帮助我的儿子接受肺移植”（Help My Son Reach His Lung Transplant）的GoFundMe众筹活动，希望为儿子的治疗和康复筹集资金。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/04/cas_auto/small_0_9280422.jpg
众筹页面介绍称，他已经与间质性肺病抗争了八年，随着病情不断恶化，最终不得不接受肺移植手术。
筹集到的资金主要用于支付移植手术相关费用、搬迁费用以及术后康复开销。最终，这项活动获得了约5000笔捐款，筹集金额超过9.6万美元，远远超过最初设定的1.5万美元目标。
在宣布他去世的消息时，家人也向所有帮助过他的人表达了感谢，称大家的支持让他生命最后几个月留下了许多美好回忆。“他当时真的非常开心，感觉自己的梦想正在实现。他也希望能够像大家帮助他一样，回馈所有人。”这名家属说道。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/04/cas_auto/small_0_9280423.jpg
除了希望能够玩到《GTA6》，他还有一个愿望，那就是让更多人听到自己的音乐。目前，家人正在计划为他举办一场气球放飞纪念活动，具体日期尚未公布。视频最后，家人再次向所有在他与病魔抗争期间给予帮助和支持的人表达了感谢。
“感谢大家，让他生命最后的几个月过得如此美好。”

items.title: 《GTA6》大小终于确认！你PS5硬盘被塞满
items.summary: 昨晚，Rockstar终于正式宣布，《GTA6》将于11月10日开启预载，有序最高需要预留212GB存储空间，而这对于不少玩家而言，可能意味着在…

content.v: 昨晚，Rockstar终于正式宣布，《GTA6》将于11月10日开启预载，有序最高需要预留212GB存储空间，而这对于不少玩家而言，可能意味着在游戏发售前，要先给硬盘来一次大扫除。
编辑观点： 《GTA6》212GB的存储需求肯定不低，但对于一款出自Rockstar之手的大型开放世界游戏来说，也并非完全无法理解。只是随着3A游戏发展，如何解决游戏体积膨胀的问题也愈发显得迫在眉睫。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041105537624.jpg
对于《GTA6》这样注定在许多方面创造纪录的游戏来说，212GB虽然巨大，但也在情理之中。尤其是考虑到Rockstar一直以来对开放世界细节的追求，如果想让游戏在内容和表现力上有更充足的发挥空间，那么游戏体积膨胀几乎是不可避免的问题。
这也在一定程度上解释了为什么《GTA6》实体版没有光盘、只有下载码：如果想在光盘里装下全部内容，以212GB的大小来看，至少需要3张光碟。这显然将大幅提升厂商生产实体版的制造成本，而考虑到《GTA6》注定大卖，这也将明显压缩厂商的利润空间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041106399995.webp
而这也让人想起了网络上流传的一张过去与现在游戏开发者对比的梗图（下图）。这些对比虽然带有夸张和调侃成分，但也反映出部分玩家对如今游戏资源优化的关注。毕竟，硬件和存储技术进步了，并不意味着开发者就应该忽视资源利用效率。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041106005804.png
当然，过去与现在的游戏开发环境存在很大差异。早期游戏受限于硬件性能和存储介质，不得不在代码、贴图和音频等方面精打细算；如今的3A游戏则拥有更精细的画面、更复杂的场景和更丰富的音视频内容，开发者也需要在开发效率、画面表现与存储空间之间寻找平衡。
但是，当一款游戏需要占用如此庞大的存储空间时，容量增长带来的硬盘压力是真实存在的，玩家也会更加关注它能否带来相匹配的体验。与此同时，主机厂商是否应该在后续硬件中提供更大的基础存储空间，也成为一个值得讨论的话题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041107153623.jpg
那么，你觉得《GTA6》需要212GB存储空间可以接受吗？你认为如今3A游戏容量越来越大，是游戏内容和画面进步的必然结果，还是开发者在资源优化方面还有提升空间？为了玩《GTA6》，你愿意卸载其他游戏腾出空间，还是会选择额外扩容？

content.v: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》即将于11月5日正式登陆Switch 2平台。游戏评分刚刚正式解禁，截止发稿，游戏在M站收录79家媒体打分，均分96，同时获得“必玩游戏”认证，目前是M站年度最高评分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041948552808.png
部分媒体点评：
GamesRadar+：100分
《塞尔达传说：时之笛》是一款足以载入史册的重制作品。它将原版游戏的魅力与奇幻色彩保留了下来，同时让玩法更加易于上手，并带来了令人惊叹的画面表现。这款作品依然拥有历久弥新的魅力，在没有牺牲1998年原作魔力的前提下，成功重现了这款有史以来最美丽的游戏之一，甚至在此基础上更进一步。
从全新配音的对话、全面翻新的迷宫，到新增谜题等内容，海拉鲁世界从未像现在这样充满生机。
VGC：100分
《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的Switch 2重制版，出色地重现了游戏史上最受喜爱的冒险作品之一。
任天堂并没有试图彻底改造这部经典杰作，而是谨慎地打磨了原作最具魅力的部分，为新一代玩家提供了体验这款作品的最佳方式，也让曾经的老玩家再次爱上它。
Eurogamer：100分
除了出色的判断与巧妙的调整之外，这款令人惊叹的重制作品还藏着一张真正的王牌。

items.title: 《嫁金钗》忘删AI水印 字幕写“可能含AI生成内容”
items.summary: 近日，热播古装剧《嫁金钗》大结局后，被观众发现正片画面残留着镜像反转的AI生成水印，剧方至今仍未回应。

content.v: 近日，热播古装剧《嫁金钗》大结局后，被观众发现正片画面残留着镜像反转的AI生成水印，剧方至今仍未回应。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261104_zy_red_164_16/154.jpg
水印出现在一段竹叶空镜画面的右上角，内容为“可能含AI生成内容”，文字呈左右反转状态。后期制作时对该AI生成素材做了镜像翻转处理，却忘了清除素材自带的标识水印，直接放进了成片。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261104_zy_red_164_16/1147.jpg
这段画面一路闯过剪辑、调色、审片、平台复核等多道关卡，却没有一个人发现问题，被质疑审核形同虚设。大家并非排斥AI辅助制作空镜，而是连基础标识都不清理的低级失误，暴露出制作态度的粗糙。话题登上热搜后，剧集官微和播出平台优酷均未做出任何正式说明，加剧了舆论发酵。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261104_zy_red_164_16/1284.jpg

items.summary: 近日，和《影之刃零》制作人“Soulframe”梁其伟自20年前《雨血》就合作至今的音乐人、《影之刃零》音乐总监薄彩生在接受英国媒体ME…

content.v: 近日，和《影之刃零》制作人“Soulframe”梁其伟自20年前《雨血》就合作至今的音乐人、《影之刃零》音乐总监薄彩生在接受英国媒体METRO采访时，谈到了《黑神话：悟空》对国产单机游戏的意义。
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元。
METRO先是抛出了一个观点，表示：“显然，在《黑神话：悟空》大获成功之后，中国游戏市场迎来了一个特殊的发展时期，至少在主机游戏领域是这样。你认为为什么这种变化会在现在发生？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041038379336.jpg
随后，薄彩生回复表示：“我想说，中国游戏行业中大约99%的游戏创作者和从业者，其实都喜欢3A单机游戏，只是过去他们不得不开发手游，因为当时的市场需求就是如此。无论是十年前还是五年前，手游都是更赚钱的领域。而且当时很多玩家还没有配置较高的个人电脑，手机更加普及，价格也更容易让人接受。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041038427976.jpg
但是，《黑神话：悟空》的出现在一定程度上改变了这一现状，薄彩生继续补充道：“但在《黑神话：悟空》发售之后，很多玩家为了体验这款游戏，购买了新的电脑、PC或者PS5。”
“于是，现在市场上出现了新一代PC和PS5玩家，他们已经做好了体验单机游戏的准备。就好像一夜之间，这些玩家突然凭空出现了一样。实际上，他们过去只是因为手机更加方便、容易接触，所以一直在手机上玩游戏。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041038472068.jpg
而这一情况也对中国游戏开发者们的观念产生了影响，薄彩生表示：“我认为，很多人都意识到了这一点。既然我们大家本来就是单机游戏爱好者，为什么不干脆开发单机游戏呢？我个人认为，事情就是这么简单。我们一直都想制作单机游戏，而我认为，现在的市场需要的是制作更加精良、更加注重故事和叙事的作品。”

items.title: 全球限量1337个！雷蛇高端PS5手柄开卖：2338元
items.summary: 全球限量1337个！雷蛇高端PS5手柄开卖：2338元

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041036134421.png
雷蛇近日公布了一款高端限量手柄——Raiju V3 Pro Signature Edition，售价高达349.99美元（约合人民币2338元），全球仅推出1337个，每台都拥有独立序列编号，预计于11月10日正式发售。这款产品不仅面向追求竞技性能的玩家，也明显带有收藏品定位。
新手柄最大的特色是采用镁合金外骨骼结构，顶部和背部使用开放式多边形设计，内部组件能够通过镂空外观直接展现。机身边缘经过特殊处理，并使用纳米涂层减少灰尘侵入。握把则采用带有细微纹理的哑光黑色TPU材料，触控板配有半透明玻璃面板和激光雕刻的雷蛇标志。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041036202350.jpg
性能方面，它保留了标准版Raiju V3 Pro的竞技配置，包括防漂移TMR摇杆、六个可重新映射的多功能按键、两个爪式握持肩键，以及四个鼠标点击式背部按键。手柄获得PS5官方授权，同时也针对PC进行了优化，搭配雷蛇HyperPolling无线技术，最高支持2000Hz轮询率。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041037019678.png
配件方面，每台手柄还附赠高级皮革收纳包、替换摇杆帽、四个可更换背键盖，以及用于更换背键的阳极氧化铝工具。

items.title: 《影之刃零》51小时才过半!博主怒喷媒体35小时速通
items.summary: 近日，海外博主@TheAnnaji发文，对当前游戏评测圈的“速通风气”提出严厉批评，并特别以知名外媒Fextralife对《影之刃零》的评测为…

content.v: 近日，海外博主@TheAnnaji发文，对当前游戏评测圈的“速通风气”提出严厉批评，并特别以知名外媒Fextralife对《影之刃零》的评测为例，直言“游戏评测文化已经彻底崩坏”。
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元！
该博主在推文中列举了《影之刃零》的媒体评测数据：有评测者在50至60小时内达成了100%全收集，而Fextralife则声称自己仅用35小时就完成了95%的进度。
对此，博主表达了强烈质疑。他指出，自己从游戏发售首日就一直不间断地游玩，目前时长已经达到51小时，但游戏进度才堪堪达到55%。
他直呼：“算算这笔账吧！Fextralife绝对不可能全程都在最高难度‘逆天者’下打通关。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041617367056.png
博主推测，由于游戏内切换难度没有任何惩罚或锁定限制，该外媒评测者很可能为了赶在解禁前出视频，中途将难度降回了普通难度，跳过了大量对话，并跟着官方的指南一路狂飙速通。此外，他还指责该评测者仅靠一套“舒适/轮椅”的Build（流派）速通了评测版，却转身就发布了各种不同武器和流派的教学视频，而实际上他根本没怎么体验过这些内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041617466507.jpg
博主在最后强调，对于一款充满弹反机制、Boss多阶段和隐藏Build的动作游戏，如果为了抢首发流量而直接跳过游戏的机制深度，那就根本不叫评测，只能叫“比谁把媒体激活码变成点击量更快”。
这番言论也再次引发了玩家社区对于媒体“抢跑评测”含金量与客观性的讨论。

content.v: 据Nintendo Everything报道，在本周出版的《Fami通》杂志中，编辑部公布了对这款游戏的评价。四位评测者分别给出了9分、9分、9分和10分，最终总分为37分（满分40分），杀入白金殿堂。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041230368060.jpg
据了解，《Fami通》称赞了游戏流畅的镜头表现、改进后的操作方式与游戏流程，以及画面表现。不过，评测也指出，与许多现代游戏相比，本作的玩法相对简单，而且有时玩家可能会不太清楚接下来该做什么。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611041231192641.jpg
事实上，《塞尔达传说：时之笛》与《Fami通》之间还有一段相当值得一提的历史。当年，最初登陆N64平台的原版游戏获得了《Fami通》的满分评价，成为该杂志历史上首款获得满分的游戏。

content.v: 市场分析机构估算显示，《 影之刃零 》在中国大陆、台湾和香港以外的Steam及PlayStation收入占比已达55%，约为1.23亿美元。评测解禁后，其美国市场单日收入连续增长，四天内约增至原来的8.5倍。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793799667_207472_jpg_r.jpg
《影之刃零》发售前已在中国市场获得较强支持。Alinea Analytics市场分析负责人估计，游戏预售量早已超过100万份，当时中国大陆、台湾和香港合计占62.5%。即使剔除这些地区，该作仍能进入Steam、Xbox与PlayStation平台2026年新作收入榜前20名。
Steam在8月中旬开放预购时，中国市场约占游戏收入的70%。8月18日State of Play展示后，美国单日收入从7.2万美元升至14.6万美元，中国市场则由23.7万美元升至89.2万美元，其他地区的收入也增长一倍以上。
评测解禁后，美国单日收入从10月25日的10.6万美元，依次升至23万美元、46.3万美元和89.9万美元。截至11月2日，中国市场累计收入占比由此前约68%降至45%，美国由10%升至18%，其他地区则由25%升至38%。上述数字均为分析机构估算，并非开发商公布的官方销量或财报数据。

items.title: 曾威胁1300万人！官方正式确认:四川已消除血吸虫病
items.summary: “四川发布”公众号宣布：近期，国家疾控局会同多部门正式印发通知，确认四川省达到血吸虫病消除状态。

content.v: “四川发布”公众号宣布：近期，国家疾控局会同多部门正式印发通知，确认四川省达到血吸虫病消除状态。
四川省曾经是我国血吸虫病重流行省之一，疫情曾波及成都、眉山、德阳、绵阳、乐山、雅安、凉山、资阳、攀枝花、宜宾、内江等11个市（州）的63个县（市、区），受威胁人口达1300余万。
于1924年首次报告血吸虫病病例，1939年发现钉螺，1943年证实耕牛感染，历史累计病人达127.57万人，晚期病人3万余人，历史病牛20万余头。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611042138127852.png
据了解，血吸虫病是由血吸虫寄生引起的人兽共患传染病，在我国流行的是日本血吸虫病，属于法定乙类传染病。该病发展至晚期，常常表现为“腹大如鼓，不分男女”的典型症状，民间形象地称之为“大肚子病”。
血吸虫的传播需要完整的链条：
首先，粪便入水，污染水体：感染血吸虫的人或动物，将含有血吸虫虫卵的粪便排入水中，虫卵在水中孵化成毛蚴。
其次，钉螺作为中间宿主：毛蚴在水中会钻入中间宿主钉螺体内，并进一步增殖发育，最终形成具有感染性的尾蚴并释放入水，这样的水体即为“疫水。
最后，无保护直接接触疫水：人或动物的裸露皮肤接触疫水，短短十几秒，尾蚴就能穿透皮肤侵入体内，造成感染。
人们常见的感染方式包括：游泳戏水、捕鱼捞虾、下河洗衣洗脚、田间劳作、水产养殖以及洪涝灾害期间被动涉水等。需要提醒，由于血吸虫为人畜共患病，中间宿主钉螺广泛存在于长江流域及以南的部分地区，每年4~10月气温适宜、水体活动频繁，感染风险依然存在，千万不能掉以轻心。
好消息是，我国血吸虫病防治工作已取得巨大成就，2023年全国实现传血吸虫病传播阻断目标，预计2030年将全面实现消除目标。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/04/small_202611042138185481.jpg

items.title: 历史首次！AMD Radeon显卡在美国亚马逊销量超过英伟达
items.summary: 可以说，AMD目前的桌面游戏GPU市场表现相当不错。尽管目前还没有旗舰级的RDNA 4 GPU，而且AMD的一些定价策略也颇具争议。AMD的业绩如此出色，以至于其在亚马逊上的Radeon GPU销量首次超过了GeForc

content.v: 可以说，AMD目前的桌面游戏GPU市场表现相当不错。尽管目前还没有旗舰级的RDNA 4 GPU，而且AMD的一些定价策略也颇具争议。AMD的业绩如此出色，以至于其在亚马逊上的Radeon GPU销量首次超过了GeForce显卡。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793799256_351253.webp
Tech Epiphany是一家收集亚马逊CPU和GPU销售数据的公司，据其在社交媒体上发布的报告显示，AMD“在美国亚马逊上的GPU销量首次超过了英伟达”。DIY游戏PC市场的整体状况依然不佳，因此GPU的总销量有所下降。然而，由于GPU本身的价格大幅上涨，整体收入却“飙升”。
如今，AMD的成功主要归功于几个关键原因。
首先，英伟达似乎已对消费级GPU市场失去兴趣。据报道，该公司已停产RTX 5090和RTX 5080，以便在AI市场崩盘前抢占先机。此外，英伟达的GPU产量似乎也在减少，导致桌面显卡价格大幅上涨。
例如，RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB显卡于2025年4月发布，当时的售价为429美元，而目前在亚马逊上的零售价已超过700美元。RTX 5060、RTX 5070和RTX 5070 Ti的情况也类似。
虽然AMD Radeon显卡的价格也有所上涨，但情况明显好转。例如，作为RTX 5070 Ti直接竞争对手的RX 9070 XT，最低售价仅为920美元，而大多数RTX 5070 Ti型号在亚马逊上的零售价都超过1700美元。
我们希望明年消费级GPU市场的情况会有所改善，因为人工智能市场放缓的预期将迫使AMD和英伟达重新关注被忽视的DIY市场。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《时之笛》重制版夺得 2026 年评论桂冠，但《GTA 6》可能有话要说
items.summary: Reviews are in for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake , and they're pretty good so far. On GameSpot's

content.v: Reviews are in for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake , and they're pretty good so far. On GameSpot's sister site Metacritic , Ocarina of Time has a review aggregate score of 96 from 81 reviews, making it the highest-reviewed game of the year so far--and with only a few months to go, it might stay in the top spot.

A few more reviews will likely filter in over the next few days from other sites Metacritic tracks, but don't expect the needle to shift much in either direction, or at all. According to Metacritic, twin-stick shooter Sektori is second for best-reviewed game of the year (93 based on 10 reviews), followed by the Switch 2 Deluxe Edition of the Resident Evil 2 remake (also 93, based on 16 reviews).

But could Grand Theft Auto 6 dethrone Link from the number one spot? Historically, mainline entries of GTA games have reviewed very well, and looking back at previous entries, they've all earned review aggregate scores that are often on par or even higher than Legend of Zelda games. Here's a quick breakdown of how GTA has done over the years:

The pattern here is that the games developed from GTA 3 onwards earned the highest metascores, and if the tradition holds, then GTA 6 should also be in the 90s when reviews land and the scores are tallied up. That's depending on if the game is actually good, but considering Rockstar's track record, GTA 6 should be a polished experience, even if the new immersive gameplay mechanics create some sense of friction for players who are used to going on crime sprees in GTA games while not worrying too much about the consequences of their in-game actions.

For now, the Ocarina of Time remake will likely remain the best-reviewed game of 2026, a feat that Nintendo and Rockstar have achieved multiple times. The Switch 2 edition of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom was the best-reviewed game of 2025, and 2017's Breath of the Wild also took the top spot. Rockstar's Red Dead Redemption 2 was 2018's best-reviewed game, as was GTA 4 in 2008 and GTA 5 in 2013. Who will emerge victorious this year? You'll have to wait until November 19 to find out when GTA 6 launches.

items.title: 育碧可能是让漫威《刀锋战士》保持活力的公司
items.summary: Time is running out for Arkane Lyon to find a buyer , but Ubisoft could acquire the Marvel's Blade developer,

content.v: Time is running out for Arkane Lyon to find a buyer , but Ubisoft could acquire the Marvel's Blade developer, according to a new report. Arkane was one of several studios that Xbox divested itself of earlier this year, and while most of those developers have since gone on to become indie studios again-- except for Ninja Theory , which is expected to be closed after deals fell through--Arkane has found itself in a tough spot as it navigates life after Microsoft.

Bloomberg reported that Ubisoft was in talks with Microsoft to acquire Arkane Lyon and help it finish work on Marvel's Blade. The report added that Microsoft is also exploring selling Arkane Lyon back to its management, but if plans fall through before a deal can be struck by December, it looks likely the studio will ultimately be shut down. Bloomberg claims Ubisoft is one of three companies that have submitted bids for Arkane Lyon, but it has not yet revealed the identities of the other two bidders.

Arkane Lyon moving to Ubisoft does make sense on paper, as both the developer and the Assassin's Creed publisher are based in France. At the same time, Ubisoft has embarked on a major restructuring process throughout 2026, setting up new Creative Houses to spearhead development on its biggest franchises and downsizing operations across the globe. Recently, Ubisoft laid off 72 people from its Skull & Bones developer, Ubisoft Singapore, and Trials studio RedLynx might be shut down next .

Marvel's Blade was announced at The Game Awards in December 2023, and since then, Arkane has gone radio silent about the game's status. Reports say it's close to completion and could launch in Q4 2027 if Arkane Lyon can keep working on it under a new publisher.

items.title: 随着 AI 溢出商店，Steam 正在收紧游戏提交规则
items.summary: Valve currently has a review backlog on Steam, as the mandatory QA check every game must pass before launch on

content.v: Valve currently has a review backlog on Steam, as the mandatory QA check every game must pass before launch on the platform has reportedly seen wait times balloon from a few days to over two weeks. The problem appears to be a massive number of builds, thought to be AI slop, that fail basic technical checks and are sent back for re-reviews, gumming up the works. To make headway and reduce back-and-forth friction, Valve has announced it's tightening the rules on what developers must verify before submitting builds.

According to Valve, developers must ensure their games can run through Steam for at least five minutes, since the platform often receives builds that have never launched through Steam. Developers must also explicitly state whether their game requires common components like DirectX, Visual C++, or .NET so Steam knows to install them automatically, and, if advertised, prove that cloud saves work.

On top of that, Steam will run automated checks to flag broken or incomplete achievements, and it will enforce stricter image categories. This is to ensure that players aren't misled by non-gameplay images posing as screenshots. Finally, dynamic reminders will pop up in the submission portal to nudge developers to deliver the content they originally promised.

Is this a response to a flood of AI slop content on Steam lately? Valve didn't directly refer to that content, but as the recent Next Fest proved, mass-produced asset flips and AI-generated shovelware were everywhere. Content like that could be choking Steam's manual review queue, and indie game platform Itch.io addressed it this week with new guidelines for submitting games.

Requiring developers to prove they've actually booted up their game and tested basic features through Steam could bring the review process back to manageable times, but it's not a silver bullet for the bad actors out there.

Developers can voluntarily disclose that AI assisted in some form in building a game, and according to Game Discovery Tool , more than 50% of the games released on Steam last month included that disclosure.

The issue has been highlighted by several studios and developers recently, including Food Devils game director Alfred Camon , who revealed that the Steam Early Access launch date for the game had been postponed after waiting over three weeks without build approval, and Wheel Make It publisher 2 Left Thumbs detailed how they missed their launch window by two weeks because of minor build rejections that sent them back to the end of an increasingly congested queue.
The developer behind Lacey's Flash Games also posted an official release update revealing a multi-day delay due to Steam's build verification pipeline.

content.v: 《GTA6》最终可能会针对PS5 Pro做专门增强。
据Power Up Gaming报道，PlayStation法国官推曾发布一条推文，似乎意外透露了这件事。不过，这条推文后来被删除了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793796425_283881_jpg_r.jpg
这条推文介绍了《GTA6》在PS5上的独特功能。按照Power Up Gaming的翻译，PS5 Pro版将获得增强，并支持PlayStation光谱超级分辨率，也就是PSSR。
借助AI提升分辨率，玩家可以在4K电视上看到更加清晰的画面。游戏将以超高清效果呈现，并显示更多细节。
游戏还会提供更高级的光线追踪效果。玩家探索游戏世界时，可以看到质量更高的反射和阴影，整体光照也会更加真实。
Rockstar此前已经表示，《GTA6》在PS5和Xbox Series X|S上都会以30FPS运行。这些增强功能应该能进一步改善画面效果，但一些更看重性能的玩家，可能仍然会在意帧率。
所以，在画面和性能方面，Xbox Series X或许仍有竞争力。Rockstar也可能一直没有把这件事告诉PlayStation和Xbox。不过，等游戏本月发售后，具体情况就能确定了。

content.v: “朋友乐色”（friendslop）这个词一直很有争议。玩家们争论的焦点是，这到底是一种亲昵的叫法，还是在冒犯这些游戏。不管你喜不喜欢，这个词现在应该不会消失了。柯林斯词典已经把它列入2026年度最佳词汇名单，并正式收录进词典。
柯林斯词典每年都会选出一个年度词汇，同时公布一些其他入选词。这些词也会和年度词汇一起收入词典。“朋友乐色”虽然进入了2026年的名单，但没有成为年度词汇，最后输给了“mogging”。“mogging”在电子游戏圈里也很常见，不过现实生活中的其他领域同样会用到它。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793789427_920030_jpg_r.jpg
相比之下，“朋友乐色”是一个专门用来形容电子游戏的词。词典给出的新定义是：“一种低预算、独立制作的电子游戏，旨在供一群朋友轻松游玩。”
这个定义很可能又会让玩家吵起来，但你也没法和词典争辩。好吧，我在开谁的玩笑?有些玩家什么都能争，而且肯定会争下去。
这个词最大的争议，来自定义里的“低预算”。被称为“朋友乐色”的游戏往往很受欢迎。它们通常是在Steam上突然爆火的独立游戏，能够吸引数万甚至数十万名玩家。因此在一些人看来，用“乐色”来称呼这些游戏，就像是在暗示它们不如别的游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793789434_458726_jpg_r.jpg
不过，很多玩这类游戏的人并不觉得这个词带有贬义。在他们看来，这只是一个名称，而且确实准确概括了这些游戏的特点。这个词还给这些游戏划出了一个新的类型。它们不用再和其他独立游戏全都混在一起，而是有了自己的标签。
至于哪些游戏能算“朋友乐色”，玩家们同样经常争论。按照词典现在给出的定义，判断标准有三个：低预算、独立制作和多人游玩。
《Peak》大概是这一类型中最有代表性的游戏，也可能正是它让“朋友乐色”这个词流行了起来。同一类型的游戏还有《Meccha Chameleon》《Repo》《Content Warning》和《RV There Yet》等。
也有人可以把《Big Walk》归进“朋友乐色”这一类。不过，它的预算比较高，这一点可能会让它不符合这个类型的标准。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793789439_324713_jpg_r.jpg
按照词典给出的定义，低预算、独立制作和多人游玩构成三个主要条件。《PEAK》《机械变色龙》《R.E.P.O.》《内容警告》和《房车到了吗？》被列为相关例子，但预算较高、玩法相近的作品能否归入其中仍有争议。词典由此确定了基本定义，玩家对其褒贬色彩和类型边界的讨论则尚未结束。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《堡垒之夜》的超稀有海盗商店代币狩猎引发了暴利和 eBay 上市浪潮
items.summary: Fortnite Players Are Doing Things Epic Would Probably Prefer They Didn't to Try to Get the Ultra Rare Pirate S

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/02/onepiecefortthumb-1793644579999.png
Update: Article updated to add a statement from Epic.

Fortnite's recently launched One Piece crossover event sent players hunting for a rare Pirate Shop Token that would let them plunder the item shop for free. Those lucky enough to find the token can use it to claim almost everything available for free for a two week period (real-money offers, gifting and Battle Pass rewards aren’t allowed). Claimed items remain permanently on the player’s account.

But, perhaps inevitably, players are now doing things that developer Epic Games would probably prefer the didn't in a bid to get ahead, sharing exploits, selling tools to automatically farm the token, and even offering to chaperone other players for a fee.

There’s no official drop rate, but players have estimated you get the token in one out of every 700,000 chests. Like I said, it’s rare. Players have found ways to expedite the process of triggering the drop. Current methods include using grenades and cannon balls to destroy chests inside locked vaults, so they can open many chests at once without going through the effort of getting a key.
One player shared a screenshot of an overlay that shows them where all the chests are in a match, while offering to help people get the token, for a paid fee. Clearly, this is not intended gameplay.
i can carry people for pirate access token ez for $ already helped 3 people lmk https://t.co/tbaS8RvLqm

Multiple accounts on eBay are also hoping to cash in, listing Fortnite accounts with Pirate Shop access for thousands of dollars. There are currently no bids on the listings — one asking for $9,000 and offering bids, another asking for $10,000 or nearest offer — but that might change as the season comes to a close on December 4.

Epic’s terms of service explicitly prohibit the buying and selling of Fortnite accounts, as well as cheating or exploiting, so anyone attempting to cash in could end up with an account ban. In such a case, they’d lose access to the account — this could also happen after you buy the account, or the previous owner could contact support and claim the account is stolen. In other words, don’t spend $10,000 on some Fortnite skins.

"Buying an account or using fake tools is a scam," Epic said in a statement . "This is just like any of the chests in Battle Royale, so every player has an equal opportunity to find Pirate Shop Access."

If you're wondering how to unlock the Pirate Shop for free items (legitimately!), we've got a full explainer on it, as well as breakdown of the entire Treasure Hunters mini-season . You can also keep up with the weekly rewards that are dropped at random from the treasure chests , and use our handy checklist to track down all pirate-themed Sprites .
Image credit: @snowslept on X .

items.title: 新款充电宝涨价太狠！以前便宜大容量快充买不到了

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288563.jpg
差友们，先做个小调查：一个 10000/20000 mAh 的充电宝，卖多少钱你会愿意掏钱？
如果只是出门给手机续个命，不追求什么超薄磁吸、百瓦快充，估计很多人的心理价位，也就到这儿了。
就拿最近几款新品来说，小米 20000mAh 的两款自带线充电（支持 22.5W 和 67W 快充），分别卖 199 和 299：
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288557.jpg
OPPO、一加的 10000mAh 充电宝（支持 33W 和 67W 快充），也卖到了 149 和 229，支持 80W 快充的 15000mAh 充电宝则卖 269：
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288556.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288561.jpg
至于华为就更狠了，两款支持百瓦快充的20000mAh 充电宝，价格直接干到了 399 和 499。。。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288559.jpg
要知道，搁以前，花个一百来块钱， 都已经能买到 25000mAh、支持 120W 快充的充电宝了。。。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288560.jpg
现在倒好，随便一款新品就奔着两三百去了，贵的甚至要小五百。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288558.jpg
至于原因嘛，除了产品本身的配置和定位变化，今年充电宝行业正好赶上了一轮新旧标准切换。
没错，它们都是支持新国标的充电宝。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288562.jpg
这次新国标，最核心的就是给充电宝的安全门槛又往上提了一截，比如电芯要通过更严格的挤压、针刺测试，还增加了 300 次充放电循环后的析锂检测。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288564.jpg
不仅如此，充电宝本身也得能监测电池温度、电压，记录异常信息，甚至每台产品还要有自己的唯一编码，方便追溯电池来源。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288567.jpg
具体的技术变化，托尼之前已经专门写过一篇文章，这里就不展开了。
咱们只需要知道，这次升级并不是给充电宝换个包装、贴个新标识就完事了，从电芯选型、保护电路，到生产检测和质量管控，厂商都得按照新的标准进行调整。
相应的，电芯、线路板、监测元器件，还有生产和检测环节的投入，自然也会增加。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288571.jpg
之前安克在接受媒体采访时，就曾预估新国标会让产品成本增加 5%～10%；但在另一篇新华社的报道中，绿联则表示，可以通过优化设计和供应链，尽量维持基础款产品的价格。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288569.jpg
所以，成本上涨是一回事，最终卖多少钱又是另一回事。
具体到前面那些涨价几十甚至上百块的新品，除了新国标带来的成本增加，恐怕还跟市场环境有关，毕竟充电宝这门生意，以后越来越难靠薄利多销赚钱，厂商自然会提高售价保住利润。
但不管怎么说，充电宝的安全标准提高，对咱们消费者来说肯定是好事，毕竟这玩意平时不是揣在兜里，就是塞在包里，谁也不希望为了省几十块钱，还得天天担心它会不会出问题。
而且这也不代表之后我们想买个充电快、容量大、价格又实在的充电宝，就没得选了。
新国标虽然已经发布，但要到 2027 年 4 月 1 日才会强制实施， 在这之前，只要符合现行要求、取得了 CCC 认证，老款充电宝依然可以正常销售。
而等到新国标正式实施，不符合新标准的产品就不能再继续生产、销售了，所以对厂商来说，接下来这段过渡期，除了要忙着推出新品，还得想办法消化手里的老款库存。
这么一来，那些不打算继续销售的老型号，没准就会陆续迎来一波降价促销，甚至有些厂商都不用等到明年，就会清仓甩货~
这对最近正好想买充电宝的差友来说，倒是个好机会，特别是一些正规品牌，之前已经上市的老款，容量和功率完全够用，碰上清仓优惠的话，大概率比现在新品还划算。
至于新国标充电宝，托尼倒觉得也不用太着急买，现在毕竟是第一批新品集中上市的阶段，很多厂商刚开始调整产品方案，供应链和生产规模也还需要时间磨合。
等后面越来越多的品牌跟进，符合新标准的电芯、保护电路逐渐成熟，生产规模上来了，成本迟早也会降下来，后面肯定还会有更多价格实在的基础款充电宝出来。
最后也想问问差友们，你们现在买充电宝，最在意的到底是什么，是容量、充电速度，还是价格？
反正托尼觉得，能把这三样做好，再把安全给安排明白，就已经是个挺不错的充电宝了。
撰文：胖虎

美编 ：素描

酷态科、各大手机厂商官网

items.title: 珍惜《影之刃零》的慷慨！还有几个能这样堆料？

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287921.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287922.jpg
「灭烛见真火，忘剑得神兵」
2025年初，在灵游坊的办公室里，我和同事游玩了一段《影之刃零》的试玩切片。
拿着灵蛇软剑和白蟒赤练两把异形武器，我们对战了大师兄与他的七星剑阵。那场试玩难度颇高，在场只有寥寥几位同行最终通关。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287923.jpg
几天之后，这段内容作为灵游坊的蛇年贺岁实机演示正式发布，成为了《影之刃零》第一个播放量破千万的视频。
我还记得那天的试玩结束后，制作人S（梁其伟），意犹未尽地又给我们重新播放了一遍片子，对呈现给我们的一切，都表现出了乐观与自豪。在他的描述中，正式版游戏里会有三十多把主副武器，还有“至少20个小时”的主线流程。
真的能做出三十多把差异如此巨大的武器吗？因为当时只玩到了单纯的Boss Rush，我其实很难对整个动作系统下判断，内心保留了一些保守和疑虑。
时隔近两年，一切都变得不一样了。恐怕当初我再怎么发挥想象力，S给出再多的言语描述，我也无法想象最终端上桌的《影之刃零》，会是这样一款远远超过当时预期的游戏。
这大概也是我从业以来，见过风评反转最快的国产游戏。
此前的媒体前瞻环节，试玩工作全由我的同事駄目糕负责。出于严格的保密原则，直到发售前夕，我实际上也无从了解具体的游戏内容，心里多少还是有一些忐忑的——因为试玩第一天，她还在跟我吐槽这里那里的问题，但仅仅一天时间过去后，我再问她游戏如何，她的反馈已经变成了完全的溢美之词。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287924.jpg
媒体评测经常会陷入这种特殊状况。在封闭的高强度游玩中 ，很多时候你根本分不清究竟是游戏后面的内容真的变好了，还是玩家斯德哥尔摩综合征发作、“自适应”了。 而且，绝大多数情况下还都是后者。
直到《影之刃零》发售的当天，这种担忧依然在我心头萦绕。第一天，游戏的Steam好评率并不高，差评杂七杂八地散落在各种问题上，优化、着色器编译、动作系统、第一章的引导、略显局促和神秘的关卡节奏，以及，粪怪……
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287925.jpg
桑吉尔夫WIN！
眼看着Steam好评率随着在线人数的升高一路下滑，我一度开始担心我司的商誉问题：
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287926.jpg
但是糕老师依然自信地在群里们劝我们别急
奇妙的事情随即发生了。《影之刃零》的社区风评，迅速在发售一天后（注意，不是一周后，是一天后）迎来了彻底的反转。到今天，其Steam好评率已经从发售当日的低点（83%），一路上升到了91%。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287927.jpg
你会发现，无论在各大论坛还是社交媒体，前一天的诋毁变成了原谅，原谅又迅速变成了激动。
随着大部队玩家的进度推进到第三章乃至第四章，《影之刃零》在内容上的底牌完全亮出，迅速征服了最挑剔的玩家。也包括我自己。
只能说，我此前积累的一切犹疑，都在经历了第三章结尾的沐小葵三连战后，彻底烟消云散。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287930.gif
谁能打完这段不收回自己所有的诋毁呢
昨天，灵游坊宣布游戏发售72小时销量突破了400万份。按照单机大作的长尾曲线推算，这也意味着《影之刃零》几乎锁定了全生命周期千万销量打底的俱乐部席位。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287928.jpg
如果你对这样的商业成绩没有概念，不妨做个横向对比：单作一千万，这差不多是不少殿堂级动作游戏前辈们竭尽全力才能达到的数字，也是一些以动作闻名的老牌工作室从未企及过的数字。
是因为所谓的“国产滤镜”吗？
我想，当任何一名玩家体验到《影之刃零》的核心内容后，都不可能会再这么说。
玩家们风评反转的契机，不一而足。
比如，有的人是在拿到了几把得心应手的武器，随着主角性能的指数级提升，突然打通了任督二脉，在肌肉的碰撞中体会到了纯粹的动作心流。没有战战兢兢的翻滚和躲刀，只有行云流水的压制、破韧、武器切换……然后，被如同武侠电影运镜般的视听演出震撼。
而更多的人，则是在推开庞镇大门的那一刻，被这座错落有致、层层嵌套的古镇关卡设计给“魇住”了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287936.jpg
平心而论，光是“庞镇”，就应该是另外一篇专门研究关卡设计的文章专研的话题了。毕竟我已经在无数地方看到了“一整部《鬼武者》有庞镇内容多吗”这样的玩笑（也可能不是玩笑）。
这些，大家只要度过了前期的内容，想必自己都有所体会。打开我的Steam好友列表，一切尽在不言中。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287935.jpg
但，相比讨论《影之刃零》具体的游戏内容之前，我其实更想聊聊作为一个玩家个体，我能接受到的、来自灵游坊的设计哲学。
因为在游戏的中后段，我感受到了一种非常久违的尊重——并非单纯是游戏的动作体验本身有多么神乎其神，而是一种 对玩家的尊重 。
更准确地说，《影之刃零》是一款极其罕见的、 真正珍惜玩家时间的游戏 。
在这里，我们可以发明一个叫做“时长性价比”的概念，可以简单理解为时长性价比＝有效游玩时长/购买价格。也就是说，作为消费者的玩家，每花一块钱，究竟能买到多少小时的实在游戏体验。
在过去十年里，为了强行拉长这个“游玩时长”的分子，整个动作游戏行业几乎集体陷入了对“魂Like”的路径依赖中。
举个例子，在魂系游戏构建的法则里，尽管确实充满精妙的关卡，但关卡的寿命却往往是靠“恶意”与“重复跑尸”撑起来的。
可《影之刃零》几乎没有任何的关卡恶意可言，怎么说呢，在这个游戏里，灵游坊加入的最变态的关卡小巧思，差不多就只是在显而易见的拐角给你塞一个自爆炸弹怪而已。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9287938.jpg
而且，这游戏里的小怪在被击杀后是默认不会刷新的。你去存档点“摇铃铛”回血整备，地图上的怪物并不会满血复活来重新堵你的路。
在游戏刚发售的时候，这一度让很多习惯了传统背板跑图和刷资源的玩家感到不适应。但很快，你会发现这个设计，引申出了一个极其清爽的探索逻辑： 在无数如迷宫般盘根错节的地图里，只要你看到前方有怪物站着，就说明这条路你还没走过。
这意味着什么？意味着你在《影之刃零》里度过的每一分钟，全部是有效时间。你不需要为了上一次Boss战的失误，在充满陷阱的窄道上战战兢兢地重跑五分钟，也不需要为了攒够升级的数值而在同一个篝火旁枯燥地刷上两个小时。
你所有的游戏时间，都在进行高密度的、有效的探索与爽快的战斗。
《影之刃零》还加入了大量的便利性探索功能，玩家洗点尝试新Build也只有非常轻微的成本。
比如银河城游戏里最常见的“能力锁”（需要获得特定后续道具或机关能力才能开启的门）。按照很多传统作品的做法，地图上是完全可以不给你自动标注之前无法打开的能力锁位置的。
等你十几个小时后拿到了新道具，两眼一抹黑，早就想不起来十个小时前哪个角落有个打不开的机关，只能全地图跑断腿去盲目排查。
而在《影之刃零》里，这些能力锁在前期起到了限制路线、作出引导避免迷路的作用，等你拿到了相应能力，又不费吹灰之力就能回去将它们打开。
以游戏目前的体量来看，如果灵游坊稍微用一点行业惯用的“小心思”，不去做诸多的便利性功能，其游戏时间完全是可以再水出5个甚至10个小时的。
但是灵游坊没有这么做。所有去过的分支、未解的谜题、需要回头探索的节点，系统都给你标得明明白白，连任务目标都有抬头高亮指引。
这就意味着，一个玩家通关时显示的40小时游戏时长，是完完全全、被高密度的新场景、新敌人、新武器与新演出填满的，没有一分钟垃圾时间的40个小时（非要说的话，就是小怪血条比较长算垃圾时间吧）。
再结合我们之前说的“ 时长性价比 ”概念，这份扎实到近乎溢出的体验，在如今的市场上简直像个异类。

items.title: 首曝八年后 老滚6重磅新官宣！信息量堪比首曝了

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288000.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288005.jpg
并发布了内容量堪比首曝的预告片。
大约一小时前，贝塞斯达发布了工作室40周年纪念视频。在视频结尾，陶德·霍华德亲自揭晓了《上古卷轴6》的副标题，还带来了一支新“预告片”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288002.jpg
这部在2018年首次亮相的《上古卷轴》系列新作，终于和其它系列作品一样拥有了完整标题：《The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel》，暂译为《上古卷轴6：哨兵》。
距离《上古卷轴6》首曝已经过去八年多，而《上古卷轴5：天际》发售也即将满十五年。相比当年首曝时的纯PPT画面，这次的预告片相对来说展示了更多的内容（主要是沙粒、卷轴和副标题），除此以外，贝塞斯达仍未公布其它任何有效信息。
不过，根据这个新名字，我们至少可以猜测，下一段冒险将前往红卫人的故乡——落锤省。
“Sentinel”，也就是哨兵城，是系列世界观中落锤省的首府。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288001.jpg
《上古卷轴OL》中的哨兵城
这也与预告中的沙漠画面相互印证，让多年来围绕《上古卷轴6》故事舞台的猜测，终于有了明确的答案。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288006.jpg
当然，游戏究竟会覆盖多大区域，仅凭一个名字还无法确定。毕竟，与哨兵城隔海相望、在地理文化上紧密相连的的高岩省也很可能作为重要游戏区域加入。
而我们还能获取的信息，就只有预告末尾，贝塞斯达所展示的纯文字了：
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288003.jpg
“卷轴只向我显露了一线微光，仿佛眼前的帷幕被稍稍掀起。 一个失落的未来。一场被逆转的胜利。时间之沙，被命运打散。” ——雅扎尔，侍奉落锤至高女王伊拉德妮的圣蛾祭司 第四纪元206年（4E 206）
《上古卷轴5：天际》的故事始于第四纪元201年，也就是说，这段引文的时间仅比前作开场晚了五年，我们得到了一条相当具体的时间线索。
至于别的信息，真的没有了。在官方推文中，贝塞斯达也表达了与玩家共度40年岁月的感谢。我们能知道的，就是“开发工作正在继续，还需要一些时间”了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288004.jpg
在贝塞斯达的官方评论区，目前有一条高赞评论是这么解读的：“这些沙砾，象征着我们等这游戏等到身上积的灰”。心怀希望，保持等待吧，朋友们。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288008.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_2649595_9288007.jpg

items.title: 奥运130年头回进非洲！东方的神秘力量也出手了

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288507.jpg
提到达喀尔这三个字，相信 99% 的差友都不知道，它其实是西非国家塞内加尔的首都。
在大家的印象里，这三个字几乎是和达喀尔拉力赛死死绑定的，满天黄沙、荒凉的戈壁、峡谷与乱石滩，到处都是改装越野车在沙漠里狂飙吃土，主打一个狂野的速度与激情。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288510.jpg
但其实， 达喀尔拉力赛早就不在达喀尔办了 ，过去快 20 年里它一直辗转在南美和沙特办赛。
可就是这种固有印象，只要提到达喀尔，很多人脑子里就直接套上了荒野滤镜，总觉得那儿大概还是一片连拉根网线都费劲的蛮荒之地。
如果这两天，你真的把视线投向达喀尔，你会发现这里不仅半点不土，反而科技味拉满。
这里有拔地而起的高楼、纵横交错的电轨、新修建的体育馆。。。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288514.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288508.jpg
在阿卜杜拉耶·瓦德体育场和城市广场上，更是上演着相当魔幻的一幕：场馆门口是丝滑秒过的云端检票，广场中央立着巨型智能大鼓。
最离谱的是，满大街的各国运动员和当地老哥，正排着长队在一台机器前猛敲非洲鼓，试图召唤来自中国的 AI 大模型。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288512.jpg
达喀尔这两天之所以这么热闹，是因为今年的 10 月 31 日至 11 月 13 日， 达喀尔夏季青奥会正在这里举行 ，来自全球的约 2700 名青年运动员，正在 153 个小项里同场竞技。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288515.jpg
虽然奥林匹克五环上那枚黑色圆环代表的就是非洲 ，但自 1896 年雅典现代奥运会复兴以来，整整 130 年间，奥林匹克综合赛事此前还从没真正踏上过非洲大陆。
原因也很现实，现代奥运赛事从来都是一场严苛的基建考试。以前办奥运，考验的是实体场馆、运动员住宿和城市通勤；而进入数字化时代后，考卷上又多了数字化基建测试。
对于缺乏大型办赛经验的非洲大地来说，基建设施始终没能达到办赛水平，这道坎一卡就是上百年。
那为什么这次达喀尔终于能把赛事办起来了呢？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288511.jpg
一方面是非洲发展迅速，基建水平进步得很快，另一方面，当然是来自遥远东方的神秘力量出手了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288513.jpg
没错，这 14 天赛期背后，相关的赛事核心系统、跨国电子签证和上百万张门票，全是由奥林匹克全球合作伙伴，来自中国的阿里巴巴兜底的。
不过，差评君仔细扒完阿里这次在达喀尔的操作后发现，他们干的活儿远不止在后台搭服务器那么简单，真正让当地老哥和各国运动员嗨起来的，其实是跑在云上的中国 AI 体验。
在给大伙展开聊之前，咱们得先了解下塞内加尔的两个灵魂符号。
第一个叫 Teranga ，这是塞内加尔沃洛夫语里的核心词汇，直译过来就是 “好客、热情款待、包容接纳” ，塞内加尔也因此被称为“ Land of Teranga （好客之国） ”，本届达喀尔青奥会的办赛理念就是“非洲欢迎，达喀尔欢庆”。
第二个是 Sabar 鼓 （萨巴尔鼓） ，它是塞内加尔的国宝级乐器，演奏讲究“一手拍鼓、一手持木杆敲击”，节奏极其热烈，是当地庆典和摔跤盛会绝对少不了的灵魂伴奏。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288526.gif
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288517.jpg
在青奥会人流最密集的官方公共区域“奥运广场（Festival Site）”里，阿里巴巴就联手达喀尔青奥组委会，把这两个文化符号装进了一个线下 AI 互动空间——The Teranga Beat。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288518.jpg
当你走到体验一体机前，根本不用找鼠标键盘，直接上手敲击面前的实体 Sabar 鼓，就能唤醒系统完成拍照。
那生成视频需要等几十秒，怎么让游客不无聊？现场直接设计了一个实体 Sabar 鼓音游小游戏，等你敲完鼓过足瘾，专属大片也出炉了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/04/origin_4630187_9288520.jpg
生成的视频不仅精准保留了本人五官特征、换上塞内加尔传统服饰，置身的地标背景更是把达喀尔的过去、现在和未来融了进去：
像是象征生命与时间的猴面包树旁，田径跑道像发光的年轮一样盘旋向上生长；
标志性的双丘山化作毛茸茸的超现实球场；
美丽的海岸线则点缀着电子玻璃与未来风建筑。
当地老哥打眼一看：“嘿，这不我家门口吗！”转头又能感受到本土文化与奥运科技碰撞出的奇妙花火。
体验完后，你还可以当场打印一张印有自己 AI 化身和二维码的实体纪念卡 （Beat Card） ，拿着卡片往终端上一扫，你的 AI 打鼓分身就会瞬间被投送到广场中央的超级大鼓巨幕上，和成百上千名全球玩家的虚拟形象同框合奏。
要是逛累了想查个攻略，旁边还配了千问大模型驱动的智能问答机，英法双语秒回赛程与青奥文化，把“听懂每一个人”的 Teranga 待客之道贯彻到底。
你可能会问，咱们中国 AI 整出来的非洲鼓，当地行家认吗？还真别说，现场真把萨巴尔鼓祖师爷级别的乐队给招来了。
塞内加尔有个传承三代、火了 60 多年的顶流鼓乐世家——Ndiaye Rose 家族，家族创始人 Doudou 曾被联合国教科文组织评为“活的人类珍宝”，连达喀尔国家大剧院都是以他的名字命名的。
原本以为这帮把打鼓刻进 DNA 的“老法师”们来体验多少会挑点刺，结果家族传人们在现场玩得比谁都嗨。
在塞内加尔传统里，萨巴尔鼓可绝不只是用来助兴的伴奏乐器，它本身就是一套被称为“鼓的对话”的精密语言。
在没有现代通讯网络的年代，老一辈鼓手靠变换手里的节拍，就能向远方村落精准传递信息，像是哪片丛林起火了、谁家新娘进门了，甚至村里有人被哪种毒蛇咬了，听鼓点就能分辨，堪称西非最早的无线电报。
从百年前村口敲鼓给远方传信，到今天通过算法生成视频，工具虽然变了，但鼓声“跨越距离连接人与人”的魂儿一点没变。正如乐团团长所说，鼓是文化与精神的载体，AI 没消解传统，反而成了把塞内加尔声音传向世界的扩音器。
也正因为这创意太顶，它直接杀进了达喀尔青奥会开幕式。阿里巴巴携手青奥组委会收集了全球 100 位青年的照片，让他们穿上开幕式同款服饰跨越重洋，在同一个虚拟舞台上共奏萨巴尔鼓，与广场巨幕上的万人合奏遥相呼应。
这也是中国企业的 AI 技术，首次以“文化共创”姿态站上奥运开幕式的聚光灯中央。
当然，在 The Teranga Beat 的热闹之外，要想撑起百年奥运的非洲首秀，阿里云在底层做的数字基建，才是真正的定海神针。
相比于欧美亚遍布的超大型云数据中心， 达喀尔当地数字基建不能说小有落后吧，也可以说是约等于没有。
以往不少跨国数据想来到西非，甚至得顺着海底光缆先绕道欧洲再折返，不仅带宽成本高，碰上赛事级别的瞬时流量洪峰也很难保证低延迟。
再加上这次青奥会赛事横跨三大赛区，都设立在快速建设期的城市里，这就难免会碰到一些电力网络的波动风险，如果这时候再用千里之外的远端云，难免有不稳定的情况发生。
所以，这次阿里云特地，部署了首个“奥运专有云底座”，采用硬核的“双 AZ 高可用架构”，相当于建了两套互相独立又实时同步的容灾机房，把票务、电子签证、赛事管理、信息发布等全量核心系统都跑在这上面，确保赛期 14 天零中断运行。
再看最直观的云端票务系统， 达喀尔青奥会是青奥会历史上，首次实现全场次付费票务的赛事，总票量达到了百万级 。
达喀尔用上的票务系统则是基于奥运专有云底座运行，在线上专门打通了国际信用卡与当地人日常习惯的移动支付渠道，通过 100 余台 PDA 设备，实现了场馆现场快速验票，稳稳保障了高并发售票与入场场景下的稳定性与实时性。
看到这儿，可能不少差友会替当地老哥操心：花这么大力气搭起来的豪华云底座，等比赛一结束，难道就原地拆掉？
毕竟在以往奥运会上，绝大多数赞助商的参与，基本都是随着闭幕式圣火熄灭也就画上了句号，也就是所谓的比赛结束，拔线走人。
但这次为达喀尔青奥会部署的专有云底座， 在青奥会结束后不会撤走，而是整体移交给塞内加尔，直接转化为塞内加尔主权云 ，持续服务当地政务与国家数字化建设。
可能有人不太理解，“主权云”这三个字对一个非洲国家到底意味着什么。
